'''Jason Foss'''<ref name="dt-21622">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/21622 Foss HD], DeckTech (Jason "jade" Foss, 21 February 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/21622/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/21622/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''jade''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi]] list on DeckTech in February 2002.
